Inspection / Maintenance Item: Are pumps free of corrosion or other damage?
Are pump pads and/or foundations in good condition and properly supporting the pumps?
Are base plate bolts in place and properly securing the pump to that foundation?
Are strainers in good working condition (i.e., strainer screens free of debris) and leak-free?
Are hydrostatic relief valves installed in the appropriate location and in good working condition?
Are all stainless steel flex connectors in good working condition (i.e., reinforcement braid is not damaged)?
Are fittings and piping associated with the pump leak-free?
Are drive belts properly aligned and in good working condition?
For shaft coupling-driven pumps, are shaft couplings properly aligned?
For shaft coupling-driven pumps, are spacing bushings in good working condition?
For gear reduction-driven pumps, are universal joints and couplings properly aligned and in good working condition?
Are drive belt guards in place and secure?
Are pressure gauges in good condition (i.e., 0 - 400 psig)?
Are bypasses in good working condition and leak-free?
Are bypasses set at the appropriate pressure differential?
